label: WRONG
reason: Event payload dataclasses (calendar.py DateChangeEvent, slider.py SliderChangeEvent, text_input.py TextInputChangeEvent) are named *Event because they are events; tabs.py TabItem is a public config/value dataclass passed to Tabs, not an event, and the same recurring kind appears unlisted in grid.py GridChildPosition and table.py TableSelection, so a new non-event dataclass in components would be told to be named *Event. Ruff config sets only line-length, nothing enforces naming.
